title: Voxi Eager Pipeline Injection-Safety Tuning
description: Modifier-release race guard (issue 101) and post-stop delivery drain (issue 115) tuning for internal/eager.

drain.description: Post-stop delivery drain bounds. The delivery policy itself is 'type unless a newer session has started'; these are only bounds around it.

delivery_deadline_ms.description: Absolute safety net in milliseconds after a stop, beyond which an abandoned generation stops typing. Must stay well above the per-job transcription timeout so it never drops real speech.

injection_timeout_ms.description: Per-delivery keystroke injection budget in milliseconds. Must exceed the 5000ms physical-modifier-release wait inside typing.TypeTextObserved.

modifier_gate.description: Buffering/staleness tuning for the modifier-release typing race.

timeout_ms.description: Staleness window in milliseconds: a gating-modifier press older than this is ignored for buffering purposes.

start_grace_ms.description: Modifier presses observed within this many milliseconds of a recording session starting are ignored, since the start hotkey itself is typically a gating-modifier press.

notify_delay_ms.description: Delay before playing the typing-paused notification after entering buffering; canceled if the session flushes before this elapses.
